intervention: restore shared output head exactly to base weights after A-only curriculum
primary_metric: performance-aligned hitting-time span on the common B-NLL interval
metric_definition: For each paired condition and seed, take cumulative-best NLL curves. Let top=min(NLL0_a,NLL0_b), bottom=max(NLL60_a,NLL60_b). Define high=bottom+0.8*(top-bottom), low=bottom+0.2*(top-bottom). Linearly interpolate first crossing steps and compute span=t(low)-t(high). Lower span means fewer B steps for the same NLL reduction after performance alignment.
primary_pass: all 5 family mean effects negative; exact one-sided family sign-flip p<=0.05
